result.summary: The page looks mostly functional and well-structured. One minor visual issue was identified.

issues.description: The notification dot (red dot) on the top-right avatar/button area appears to be floating slightly outside or at the very edge of its parent circle container, which could look unintentional depending on design intent.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the notification badge is properly anchored with correct positioning relative to its parent element, using standard badge positioning (e.g., top-right corner with consistent offset).
